notes.title: Update 0.5 (MAP)
notes.content:
[h1]MAP COMPLETED[/h1]
We have finished adding all the components required for the game map.
The bathrooms are now open so that our patients can go and look at themselves in the mirror, maybe they will find what they were looking for.
The doors with their respective frames, the one in the kitchen is now interactive, you have to push to pass through it.
Updated the collisions of some objects.
The lights that were removed in order to upgrade to UE5 Lumen are back.


[h1]Improvements to 3D objects.
Syringe in the infirmary cupboard.


[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
No previous bugs have been reported so we haven't had to fix anything during the development of this update.

Upcoming updates....
0.6 Tutorial
0.7 UI Redesign

notes.title: Update 0.4 SFX
notes.content:
[h1]Sound effects[/h1]
Sound effects have been added for all crappy treatments in the game.
Now every time your character stops to perform the treatment animation, you will hear the effect that goes along with the treatment animation.

[h1]3D object improvements[/h1]
The curtain for the nursing.

[h1]General updates[/h1]
Reduced the number of starting cards to 2.
Separated the button to throw cards, right click to yourself and left click to other players.
Added in the description of the syringe and stethoscope the button used to use them.
Removed the option to change name.
Chat has been removed.
Added left Shift button to use the trash and discard cards and moved the UI button.
Added left Alt button to pick up cards.

[h1] Bug fixes [/h1]
Sickness card in the centre of the screen without drawing or explanation.
Black colour of coffee smoke and pot.
Number buttons were activated where there were no cards.
AI stuck on the floor after using the alarm.
Animation of card that stayed activated when using the syringe and stethoscope.
Arrows would pop up if you held the card in the centre.


Upcoming updates....
0.5 Completely finished map
0.6 Tutorial
0.7 User interface redesign

notes.title: Update 0.3 Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Achievements[/h1]
14 new achievements have been added to the game.
More achievements coming soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41844694/0d57754b4921b30139a88237c6864cc64e3db33b.png[/img]

[h1]New 3D objects.[/h1]
The nursing bed.
The curtain for the nursing.

[h1]General Updates[/h1]
Added the rules within the game.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
A bug that reloaded the wrong resolution on the main menu screen.
Bug that caused you to not be able to switch roles again after using the movement aversion card.
Error that sometimes caused the name of who was thrown a card to the right of the screen to not appear.
When a mental illness was ruled out there was a chance that the walking input would not be reactivated.
